actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.getCountryOfOrigin.description: Find the likely countries of origin of a name, from a first name, full name or email address
actions.getCountryOfOrigin.props.input_t: What kind of value you are providing
actions.getCountryOfOrigin.props.value.d: The first name, full name or email address to look up
actions.getGenderByEmail.description: Predict the gender of a person based on their email address
actions.getGenderByEmail.props.country_c: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to improve accuracy (e.g., "US", "DE")
actions.getGenderByFirstName.description: Predict the gender of a person based on their first name
actions.getGenderByFirstName.props.count: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to improve accuracy (e.g., "US", "DE")
actions.getGenderByFullName.description: Predict the gender of a person based on their full name
actions.getGenderByFullName.props.countr: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to improve accuracy (e.g., "US", "DE")
actions.getGenderByFullName.props.full_n: The full name (first and last name) to query
actions.getStatistics.description: Get account statistics including remaining credits and usage information
auth.description: Your Gender API authentication token. Sign in at gender-api.com, open your account, go to Authentication Tokens and copy a token. New accounts must confirm their email before the token works.
description: Predict gender from a first name, full name or email, and find the likely country of origin of a name, using Gender API.
